hero.title: Volunteer With Us
hero.description: Join our team of dedicated volunteers and make a meaningful impact in preserving and promoting Tamil culture and heritage.

intro.title: Why Volunteer?
intro.content: Volunteering with Thamizhi is a rewarding way to give back to the Tamil community while developing new skills and building lasting connections. Whether you have a few hours a month or can commit to regular involvement, there is a place for you in our organization.

opportunities.title: Event Coordination
opportunities.description: Help plan, organize, and manage cultural events, festivals, and community gatherings.

opportunities.title: Language Teaching
opportunities.description: Assist in Tamil language classes for children and adults at various skill levels.

opportunities.title: Cultural Programs
opportunities.description: Support traditional arts, music, and dance programs by mentoring students or assisting instructors.

opportunities.title: Community Outreach
opportunities.description: Help connect with Tamil families in the area and spread awareness about our programs and services.

opportunities.title: Digital and Media
opportunities.description: Contribute to our website, social media presence, photography, or video documentation of events.

opportunities.title: Youth Mentorship
opportunities.description: Guide young community members through leadership development and cultural education programs.

benefits.title: Volunteer Benefits
items: Build meaningful connections within the Tamil community
Contribute to cultural preservation for future generations
Gain experience in event management and community service
Receive recognition at annual volunteer appreciation events
Access to exclusive community programs and resources

cta.title: Ready to Make a Difference?
cta.description: Fill out our volunteer interest form and a member of our team will reach out to discuss how you can get involved.
